I've just finished setting up the static assets for the Teich Studio web UI: I added the xterm.js vendor files, copied the logo SVG, wrote the index.html, style.css, and app.js with the terminal client. I then ran the test suite and the linter, both of which passed cleanly, confirming that the frontend rebuild didn't break any existing functionality.

Next, I started a preview server using the special `mcp__Claude_Preview__preview_start` tool, which gave me a server ID (`ba456321-2520-43d4-8180-05f69d5a0984`) and a port (8426). The purpose of this preview server is to let me visually verify that the new UI renders correctly, that the xterm terminal loads, and that the branding (logo, colors, layout) appears as intended.

The logical next step is to capture a screenshot of the running preview so I can inspect the result (and later show it to the user). The preview tool provides a `preview_screenshot` action that takes the `serverId` and returns an image. Since I already have the server ID from the start call, I can directly request a screenshot. This will give me immediate visual feedback without needing to manually open a browser.

Therefore, the appropriate next action is to invoke `mcp__Claude_Preview__preview_screenshot` with the serverId I just received.
